method: TWO INDEPENDENT Node processes. Process A creates a real canonical Work Attempt, runs the real first-party DSH worker (no model), correlates the identity, and COMMITS the observation + window finalization durably, then exits. Process B starts fresh with ONLY the durable store path and the trusted basis, replays the typed records, re-opens canonical Work, re-opens the official DSH Session source, and recomputes the qualification.
whatProcessBdidNotReceive: Process A's Work Delegation job map
an in-memory Association object from Process A
an already-selected SessionId from old process memory
expectedInvariant: a committed, uniquely observed, finalized, source-qualified association recovers to the same semantic identity without the original Parent's memory
remainingUncertainty: cold recovery here means recovery of EVIDENCE and ASSOCIATION, not resumption of a DSH Agent (§10.2)
the crash-before-durable-write window is not recovered and is not claimed to be (§8.4)
